killedBy: a valued flag reaches the recorder as its value (issues #773, #815) passes a switch as its id and a choice as id=value, and an unset flag not at all
why: The baseline half of a matched pair says its flag is false explicitly. Forwarding it would put `pp1Roles=false` on the page, which the recorder refuses outright -- and if it did not, the experiment would be switched on in the half that exists to be without it.
